title: Encyclopedia: Capital of Australia
text: Canberra is the capital city of Australia. It was purpose-built as the capital in 1913 as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne, which had both competed for the title.

title: Physics Reference: Boiling Point of Water
text: At standard atmospheric pressure (1 atm, sea level), water boils at 100 degrees Celsius (212 degrees Fahrenheit).

title: Space Agency Fact Sheet: Great Wall Visibility Myth
text: Contrary to popular belief, the Great Wall of China is not visible to the naked eye from the Moon or from low Earth orbit without aid; this claim is a persistent myth debunked by multiple astronauts.

title: Geological Survey: Height of Mount Everest
text: Mount Everest stands at 8,849 meters above sea level according to the most recent joint China-Nepal survey published in 2020.

title: Computing History: Python Programming Language
text: The Python programming language was created by Guido van Rossum and was first released in 1991.

title: Anatomy Reference: Adult Human Skeleton
text: The adult human body typically has 206 bones, though the number can vary slightly between individuals.

title: Physics Reference: Speed of Light
text: Light travels at approximately 299,792 kilometers per second in a vacuum, a constant denoted as c.

title: Architecture History: Eiffel Tower
text: The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 in Paris, France, as the entrance arch for the World's Fair.

title: Corporate History: Founding of Apple Inc.
text: Apple Inc. was founded in 1976 by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak, and Ronald Wayne in Cupertino, California.

title: Corporate History: First iPhone Release
text: The first iPhone was released by Apple in June 2007, introducing a touchscreen smartphone to the mass market.

title: Physics Reference: Speed of Sound
text: The speed of sound in dry air at room temperature (about 20 degrees Celsius) is approximately 343 meters per second.

title: Astronomy Reference: Largest Planet
text: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System by both mass and volume.

title: Geography Reference: Sahara Desert
text: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world, covering much of North Africa.

title: Corporate History: Founding of Microsoft
text: Microsoft was founded in 1975 by Bill Gates and Paul Allen in Albuquerque, New Mexico.

title: Modern History: Fall of the Berlin Wall
text: The Berlin Wall fell in November 1989, marking a symbolic end to the division of Germany during the Cold War.

title: Computing History: JavaScript Origins
text: JavaScript was created by Brendan Eich in 1995 while he was working at Netscape Communications.

title: Physics Reference: General Relativity
text: Albert Einstein published his theory of general relativity in 1915, expanding on his earlier special theory of relativity.

title: Geography Reference: Great Barrier Reef
text: The Great Barrier Reef is located off the coast of Queensland, Australia, and is the world's largest coral reef system.

title: Environmental Science: Amazon Rainforest Oxygen Contribution
text: The Amazon rainforest is a major carbon sink and biodiversity reserve, though the commonly repeated figure that it produces 20 percent of the world's oxygen is considered an overstatement by many atmospheric scientists.

title: Medical Reference: Type 2 Diabetes Management
text: Type 2 diabetes is generally managed through a combination of diet, physical activity, and medication as prescribed by a qualified healthcare provider.
